# TravelConnectly

> Independent guides that help travelers stay connected abroad: eSIM data plans compared by country with dated prices, and VPNs compared by trip type. Run by Eron, a solo traveler. The site earns affiliate commissions (Saily, NordVPN, Surfshark, Proton VPN, SafetyWing, Wise) and says so on every page; rankings are not paid for, and pages state where a non-partner is cheaper.

## eSIM guides by country
- [Best eSIM for the USA](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-usa.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, fixed and unlimited plans, Hawaii/Alaska coverage
- [Best eSIM for Japan](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-japan.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (KDDI, SoftBank), setup
- [Best eSIM for Thailand](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-thailand.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (AIS, True)
- [Best eSIM for Turkey](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-turkey.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, what to install before arriving
- [Best eSIM for Canada](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-canada.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (Bell, Telus), unlimited vs fixed data
- [Best eSIM for Italy](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-italy.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (WindTre, Vodafone), EU roaming
- [Best eSIM for Spain](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-spain.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (Orange, Movistar, Vodafone, Yoigo), EU roaming
- [Best eSIM for Europe](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-europe.html): regional plans compared: prices, which countries each covers (UK, Switzerland, Turkey, Balkans, Kosovo)
- [Best eSIM for UK](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-uk.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (EE and others), EU roaming after Brexit
- [Best eSIM for France](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-france.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (Orange, SFR, Bouygues, Free), EU roaming
- [Best eSIM for Greece](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-greece.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (Nova, Vodafone), islands and ferries
- [Best eSIM for Mexico](https://www.travelconnectly.com/best-esim-for-mexico.html): Saily vs Airalo vs Holafly, networks (Telcel, Movistar, AT&T); Airalo cheapest here
- [Saily vs Airalo](https://www.travelconnectly.com/saily-vs-airalo.html): head-to-head prices in 12 destinations, unlimited vs fixed data
